purpose: Offline, case-level semantic coverage for the retired wowdoc and wowdata business inventory. Evidence points to current tests, retained fixtures, or an intentional 2.0 contract; they never claim that a retired executable was run.

assertions: version and build provenance remain machine readable
fresh workspace creation is separated from source synchronization and indexing
old home data is not imported
cases.note: 2.0 deliberately splits the old all-in-one initializer and uses a fresh workspace contract.

assertions: there is no legacy package self-update alias
cases.note: Distribution and update belong to the single Toolkit package; the old wowdoc updater is not a public command.

assertions: cache cleanup is policy driven
fresh/archive workspace handling is explicit
cases.note: The broad legacy clean verb was replaced by explicit cache and workspace operations.

assertions: component removal is explicit
old workspace and user data are not silently deleted
cases.note: 2.0 does not retain a broad uninstall alias.

assertions: diagnostics are read only
capability failures are structured
source and product identity are listed
fixed snapshot readiness is visible
mirror freshness is reported by capability diagnostics
source validate keeps addon validation meaning
cases.note: The old source check is intentionally folded into doctor; source validate is not its alias.

assertions: selected source/product/ref becomes a fixed snapshot
partial synchronization is visible
index publication is immutable
parse diagnostics are retained
refresh uses the same explicit fixed-snapshot index action
cases.note: 2.0 has one source index action and no legacy refresh alias.

assertions: active snapshot and parser/index readiness remain observable
topic filtering and evidence-tier ranking are preserved
results are bounded and deterministic
exploratory mode includes weaker evidence tiers
search and explore share one engine
qualified symbol lookup uses the pinned source
fallback search remains bounded
path and line spans are read from the fixed source
path traversal is rejected
from and to are explicit
changes are grouped and bounded
TOC/XML closure is ordered
stable diagnostic codes and source evidence are retained
cases.note: The fixture covers static closure and diagnostics, but not every historical source tree or live addon combination.

assertions: duplicate target IDs are rejected
matrix results merge explicit product/ref diagnostics
read-only enforcement
exactly-one input source
named parameters and JSON/JSONL/CSV completeness
provider identity is explicit
pagination, filters, malformed payloads and CSV are bounded
cases.note: Wago/DBCache/Raidbots adapters and failure semantics are covered by controlled fixtures; this is not complete live-server coverage.

assertions: identity preparation is separated from on-demand content preparation
no implicit latest target is created
cases.note: 2.0 intentionally removes the broad warmup verb and resolves only the identity needed by a query.

assertions: schema fields, keys and relationships are typed and pinned
single ID and bounded page reads preserve typed values
after-id pagination is stable
cases.note: The retained DB2 sample proves typed reads and paging, but does not represent every historical table and array/locale shape.

assertions: case-insensitive field search is bounded and read only
foreign-key field/value selection preserves relation semantics
mandatory bounds prevent accidental unbounded reads
JSONL has legal begin/record/end frames
truncation and cancellation are visible
cases.note: The protocol is tested with synthetic DB2 input; large real-build streaming remains not_run.

assertions: trigger and description closures are bounded
relation provenance is retained
aura presence and absence are distinct results
summon effects and optional NPC filtering are preserved
section tree, related spells and relation manifest are bounded
encounter relation and asset output are separate explicit actions
manifest preserves both sources
cases.note: 2.0 deliberately splits relation lookup from generic asset export instead of keeping a compound exporter.

assertions: listfile source and bounds are explicit
ID/name/extension queries do not export bytes
raw bytes are source-pinned and atomically published
existing output requires explicit overwrite
existence and CASC encoding metadata remain distinct from decoded content
BLP2 mip/channel selection is real
PNG/WebP output is bounded and verifiable
cases.note: Synthetic BLP2 formats and independent decode checks pass; full multi-build real texture coverage remains not_run.

assertions: identity and cache accounting are separate read models
cases.note: 2.0 splits CASC identity from cache accounting to keep the interfaces deep and explicit.

assertions: product/build identity comes from manifests
historical builds require exact selection
cases.note: Manifest and exact-build selection are covered offline; cold CDN listing for every region is not_run.

assertions: diagnostics remain read only
source, cache and archive failures are distinguishable
cases.note: The old broad CASC group is intentionally split across doctor and cache verify.

assertions: item relationships and race/gender inputs are preserved
referenced assets remain IDs with source provenance
display and model-file lookups retain variant data
ID/item/model lookup modes are explicit and bounded
VP9 AVI metadata and bounded frame export agree with the retained oracle
partial output is never reported complete
named targets preserve explicit identity and reference protection
there is no implicit old profile store
cases.note: 2.0 replaces profiles with named targets and fixed DataPins; old profile data is not imported.

assertions: protected/duplicate/resume/derived usage taxonomy is visible
content hashes are checked without destructive repair
protected and in-use objects are skipped
dry-run and target budget are honored
no broad destructive clear alias exists
policy-driven pruning is explicit
cases.note: 2.0 does not port a destructive cache clear command.

assertions: workspace budgets are stored in the new config contract
old wowdata config is not imported
cases.note: Configuration is a Toolkit workspace concern, not a wowdata-specific compatibility surface.

assertions: installation, target, cache and network capability checks are read only
no legacy package update alias remains
cases.note: The single Toolkit distribution owns updates.

assertions: removal is explicit and recoverable
old data is not silently deleted
cases.note: The old broad uninstall path is intentionally retired.

assertions: golden work remains test tooling, not a public runtime verb
retained oracles are consumed offline
cases.note: 2.0 keeps golden comparison in tests and does not advertise a public golden command.

assertions: cold network discovery reports source identity and failures
offline mode never substitutes latest
cases.note: Controlled HTTP adapters prove selection and failures; live CDN availability across all supported regions is not_run.

assertions: build identity is exact
cache reuse cannot cross pins
corrupt entries fail closed
cases.note: Offline identity and cache isolation are covered; a full matrix of real client builds is not_run.
